definitions.explanation: Based on immediate understanding without conscious reasoning; relying on intuition.

examples.japanese: {直感的|ちょっかんてき}に{分|わ}かった。
このアプリは{直感的|ちょっかんてき}な{操作|そうさ}ができる。
examples.english: This app has an intuitive interface.

examples.japanese: {直感的|ちょっかんてき}に{危険|きけん}を{感|かん}じた。

notes:
{直感的|ちょっかんてき} is a na-adjective meaning intuitive or instinctive.

WORD FORMATION:
{直感|ちょっかん} (intuition) + {的|てき} (~like, ~al) suffix.

FORMS:
- {直感的|ちょっかんてき}な + noun: intuitive [noun]
- {直感的|ちょっかんてき}に: intuitively (adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直感的|ちょっかんてき}な{操作|そうさ}: intuitive operation
- {直感的|ちょっかんてき}に{分|わ}かる: to understand intuitively
- {直感的|ちょっかんてき}なデザイン: intuitive design

USAGE:
Common in technology contexts for user-friendly interfaces.

CONTRAST: {論理的|ろんりてき} (logical) vs {直感的|ちょっかんてき} (intuitive).
